{{Quote|This cave was established by a crazed droid engineer and served as a place to operate on his droids, making them lethal killing machines.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Colonel Darkstone"}}</ref>}}
'''Sardeya Elgrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I have three bounties on Lok I haven't had a chance to collect. You take care of them for me, and I'll split the bounty with you.|[[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BBP" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the disbarred [[Droid/Legends|droid]] engineer Sardeya Elgrin lived on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> She inhabited a [[Droid Engineer's Cave|cave]] located in the heart of a volcano, the [[Mount Chaolt]]. There, she performed lawless experiments that would not allowed on any of the more civilized worlds,<ref name="SWG:DEC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Droid Engineer's Cave|Lok}}</ref> experimenting to improve the droid lethal capacities.<ref name="SWG:CD" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the outcast [[Andria E'liyha]] tried to convince a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to attack the cave in order to kill the insane engineer and remove insanity from Lok.<ref name="SWG:AE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Andria E'liyha|Lok}}</ref> Later, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Balfur Jhcor]] discovered the presence of Sardeya Elgrin on Lok. Bossk proposed to a spacer encountered on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to split the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]]. The adventurer therefore traveled to Lok and tracked the engineer to the cave. The spacer attacked Sardeya Elgrin and finally killed her.<ref name="SWG:BBP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sardeya Elgrin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The droid engineer of the [[Droid Engineer's Cave]] was first mentioned upon the original release of the game.<ref name="SWG:DEC" /> but was only added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
